name: Tapfiliate
desc: Affiliate tracking and conversion management platform.

actions.name: create_affiliate
actions.description: Creates a new affiliate in Tapfiliate.

actions.name: get_affiliate
actions.description: Retrieves a Tapfiliate affiliate by ID.

actions.name: list_affiliates
actions.description: Lists affiliates with optional Tapfiliate filters.

actions.name: create_conversion
actions.description: Creates a conversion in Tapfiliate. At least one attribution field is required: Customer ID, Referral Code, Tracking ID, Click ID, Coupon, or Asset ID + Source ID together.

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
